notes: Paper presents new measured exclusion limits on scalar coupling d_e of ultralight bosonic dark matter to photons (fine-structure constant variation). Constraints derived from optical atomic clock comparisons: νE3/νE2 (171Yb+ E3 vs E2 transitions) and νE3/νSr (171Yb+ E3 vs 87Sr). Data points extracted from Fig. 4 exclusion plot showing improvement by >1 order of magnitude over previous bounds in mass range ~10^-23 to ~10^-18 eV. DM density ρ_DM ≈ 0.4 GeV/cm³ used in conversion from measured amplitude modulations to coupling limits via Eq. 8. Confidence level 95% as stated. Coupling type is ScalarPhoton because the paper constrains oscillations of the fine-structure constant α through a scalar field coupling to photons (Lagrangian term ∝ d_e F_μν F^μν).
